guidance.statement: Polycarbonate resin plant project expected to be commissioned by June 2028.
guidance.quote: we are expecting it to be commissioned by June 2028.

guidance.statement: INR 11,000 crore total project funding tied up with banks in a 60-40 debt to equity ratio.
guidance.quote: The funding is for all the projects together. We have tied up with the banks for debt. It will be in the ratio of 60-40.

guidance.statement: Agrochemical intermediates and MIBK/MIBC projects scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27.
guidance.quote: multipurpose agrochemical intermediates and MIBK, MIBC projects, which are scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27.

guidance.statement: Commercial production of fluorinated and non-fluorinated molecules anticipated on regularized basis from Q3 FY27 onwards.
guidance.quote: we anticipate commercial production on a regularized basis from Q3 onwards

guidance.statement: Expects stronger margin profile for standalone business in FY27 compared to FY26 due to new accretive products.
guidance.quote: Therefore, in FY27, we expect a stronger margin profile, even for the standalone business, compared with FY26.

guidance.statement: Expects Q1 FY27 performance to be better sequentially than Q4 FY26 on standalone and consolidated levels.
guidance.quote: I can say that our Q1 looks on track for numbers, which are better than Q4, whether it is on standalone or on a consolidated basis.

achieved.claim: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenues stood at INR 2,127 crore with 18% EBITDA margin.
EBITDA for Q4 FY26 reached INR 383 crore, a sequential growth of 74%.
Successfully commissioned, stabilized, and ramped up nitration and hydrogenation facilities at Dahej in FY26.
Q4 FY26 PAT grew 120% quarter-on-quarter to INR 220 crore.

pushback.concern: Technical issues leading to suboptimal 45% utilization at the newly started nitric acid plant.
Suboptimal utilization and raw material availability constraints for Phenolics business.
Increase in receivable days and potential underutilization in Advanced Intermediates.
Discrepancy in Phenol spreads between China and India impacting local pricing.

output.tone_why: Management highlighted strategic RM stockpiling, margin expansion, sequential profitability gains, and clear capex execution plans.
